description: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand at the sides of your chest, press them up until your arms are straight, then lower them back to your chest.
Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest, sit your hips down until your thighs are about level with the floor, then stand back up.
Rest on your forearms with your elbows under your shoulders, lift your knees so your body forms a straight line from head to heels, hold, then lower your knees.
